correctness.rationale: Uses the explicitly credited type-B signed set-partition bijection of Buck et al. The zero block containing 1 has size b and contributes the first descent at 2b−1 if b≥2; each subsequent block with s_i positive/negative choices and q_i negative elements contributes descents at p+2q_i (if q_i>0) and at p+2s_i−1 (if s_i−q_i≥2). Choosing the remaining zero-block labels and each ordinary block from the smallest unused label yields precisely binom(n−1,b−1)∏ binom(n−a_{i−1}−1,s_i−1)binom(s_i−1,q_i); grouping by the stated Delta gives the exact N_n(T) for all n and T. A run composition corresponds bijectively to the set of cumulative descent positions. A memoized suffix DP over remaining labels, with O(r²) block choices per r, uses O(n³) arithmetic operations. Independent direct generation of all Stirling words by insertion of next adjacent maximum, testing original flattened condition, matched a separately computed signed-block formula for n=1..6 with totals 1,2,6,24,116,648 and 1,2,4,9,19,41 different descent profiles.
residual_risks: Direct finite computations independently checked specific cases only; infinite assertions are supported by the reconstructed analytic proof, not computer output.
